verdict.rationale: LiveKit's own docs say you can bring an agent to a web or mobile app, which implies first-party client support beyond the browser. The community report of using it with Svelte supports the web side only. Nothing in the pack names official iOS or Android SDKs or documents a shared session and track model across them, so this is a thin, glancing mention. Missing for 10: explicit official iOS and Android SDK documentation, evidence of the same room/session/track model across platforms, independent mobile hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Bring your agent to life through a web or mobile app.
It worked great with Svelte, and deploying a local dev server was easy.
